stage.quote: On 9 January 2026, MiniMax held its initial public offering on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to become a listed company.
stage.note: IPO'd on HKEX (ticker 0100.HK) on 9 January 2026; last priced private round before that was the March 2024 $600M round led by Alibaba.

last_round.quote: In March 2024, Alibaba Group led a $600 million financing round for MiniMax giving it a valuation of $2.5 billion.

revenue.basis: Company 2025 Annual Report, as cited in Wikipedia infobox (financials as of 31 December 2025)

note: MiniMax (developer of the models/agent product covered by the card, e.g. MiniMax Agent / MaxClaw, platform.minimax.io) is now a public company: it completed its HKEX IPO on 9 January 2026 (ticker 0100.HK). FY2025 company-wide revenue was US$79.038M but operating/net loss was US$-1.8716 billion (per its 2025 Annual Report, likely driven by fair-value/share-based pre-IPO instrument charges typical of Chinese tech IPOs) against only US$1.0884B total assets and negative US$-2.648B total equity — a buyer should treat this as a recently-listed, still loss-making company, not a well-capitalized incumbent. No first-party sandbox/VM/compute pricing exists; the product surface priced in the card (Token Plan subscriptions / API credits) is downstream of the parent company's own model-hosting business, not a standalone infra vendor.
